sourceMethod: Actual MeshStandard programs, Prairie ground, packed road triangles and Float32 instanced paint transforms. Emissive uniforms identify floor/road/paint coverage; no replacement depth shader. Native GLES, no browser or performance claim.
orderBoundaryMethod: Only MSAA changed pixels with no coverage in a true single-sample, depth-disabled raster of the identical near/far-clipped opaque ground geometry AND no paint-only coverage are reported separately as sample-boundary ambiguity. All surface-interior or paint changes remain failures. Raw order differences are retained.
textureScope: Opaque diagnostic texture samples retain actual map/bump shader variants. Texture appearance and lighting are outside this depth-ID test; alpha-tested/displaced materials are rejected.
